items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: The first band that I played were a dance band that had a violin. That's when I tell you that I played at the Black Orchard... That's when we had Oscar Marco and his brother, Mickey Marco.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear any hot fiddle players? That's what I was going to ask about.
Yeah, I heard. Hot fiddle players. Now you take like Oscar Marco. You take like Bonuti.
